ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers Toolkit
ModMetadata.Author: Shane Yu
ModMetadata.Description:
Enabled remote editing of IC10 chips and LUA chips, when StationeersLua is installed, via an external IDE using our Stationeers Toolkit VS Code extension.
Stationeers Toolkit adds a friendly live network and chip editor for IC10, with Lua chip editing available when StationeersLua is also installed. Without StationeersLua, the mod still works for IC10 chips.
You can use this alongside the StationeersLua extension, though editing the same code in both extensions at once is not recommended. Stationeers Toolkit is a great choice if you also want IC10 language support, testing, scenarios, and the other features in the extension.
VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=shaneyu.stationeers Open VSX: https://open-vsx.org/extension/shaneyu/stationeers
